ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black/grey) pixel distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary lobes are dominated by contiguous high-intensity white pixels. Low-intensity black/dark-grey pigmentation is concentrated in a broad vertical band ascending from the median notch and along the trailing edge. Distinct small, low-intensity circular blobs are clustered on the distal upper region of the right fluke lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees, exhibiting deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks (5-15 pixel depth) and valleys; serrations are most pronounced and jagged on the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve mapping from the distal tips to the central notch along the trailing edge, while the leading edge demonstrates a broad convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both flukes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns. Darker localized spots are visible on the mid-right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented horizontally and diagonally, intersecting across the high-intensity regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple intersecting linear rake marks across both lobes and significant barnacle encrustations located on the distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'dotted' pigmentation cluster on the upper margin of the right fluke tip and a centralized dark pigment column extending from the peduncle through the median notch.
